title: Alwida Alwida
body:
Alvida Alvida Ali Akbar Alvida
Alvida Alvida Ali Qasim Alvida
Alvida Alvida Al Asghar Alvida
Alvida Alvida Aun O Muhammad Alvida
Alvida Alvida Ya Abbas Alvida
Alvida Alvida Ya Shaheed E Bekhata Naz E Dasht E Nanewa Shah E Karbala
Kar Qabool Behan Ka Salam Ya Hussain
Qaid Ho Ky Jarhi Hon Sham Ya Hussain
Dil Mein Teri Yad Hai Asara Sajjad Hai
Sath Ibn E Saad Hai Mein Ho Be Rida
Alvida Alvida Ya Shaheed E Bekhata Naz E Dasht E Nanewa Shah E Karbala
1.Khatam Hogaye Hain Sare Asare Akbar O Abbas Mere Na Rahy
Qatiloun Ki Bher Hai Hamri Har Taraf
Jane Ko Tayear Ab Hai Qaidiyun Ki Saf
Ibn E Shah E Bu Turab Hogaye Hon Be Hijab
Laut Aoun Kamyab Dey Mjhe Dua
Alvida Alvida Ya Shaheed E Bekhata Naz E Dasht E Nanewa Shah E Karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Kia Sunayn Dard E Fakhar E Punjatan
Chaahe Meine Lakh Hain Kiye Jatan
Mein Rida E Innama bacha Nahi Saki
Bhai Teri Lash Py Mein Nahi A Saki
Aag Thi Khayam Thy Ya Hussain Ya Hussain
Aag Thi Khayam Thy Jin Mein Do Imam Thy
Bachy Tishna Kam Thy Ati Kis Tarhan
Alvida Alvida Ya Shaheed E Bekhata Naz E Dasht E Nanewa Shah E Karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Chup Na Jaye Tera Be Gunnah Lahu
Jarahi Hon Is Liye Mein Ko Ba Ko
Ja Ky Mein Batungi Ti Be Missal Hai
Tu Baqae Deen Hai Tu Lazawal Hai
Shah E Be Nawa Hai Tu Ya Hussain Ya Hussain
Shah E Be Nawa Hai Tu Rooh La Ilaha Hai Tu
Fakhar E Ambiya Hai Tu Raaz E Kibriya
Alvida Alvida Ya Shaheed E Bekhata Naz E Dasht E Nanewa Shah E Karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Mein Na Rukne Dungi Tera Ghum Hussain
Mein Na Jhukne Dungi Ye Alam Hussain
Mein Hussainiyat Ko Yun Bacha Ky Aungi
Hasher Tak Rahyega Tu Ya Hussain Ya Hussain
Hasher Tak Rahyega Tu Is Tarhan Jiyega Tu
A Ky Khud Kahye Gat U Bahen Shukria
Alvida Alvida Ya Shaheed E Bekhata Naz E Dasht E Nanewa Shah E Karbala
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Chor Kar Chala Jo Dasht E Karbala
Malka E Hay Aka Qaidi Qafla
Boli Ro Ky Shah Se Ye Dukhtar E Imran
Tishna Lab Ghareeb Bhai Mein Tere Qurban
Dil Ghumo Se Choor Hai Ya Hussain Ya Hussain
Dil Ghumo Se Choor Hai Ur Sham Door Hai
Jan Bhi Zarur Hai Bhai Alivida
Alvida Alvida Ya Shaheed E Bekhata Naz E Dasht E Nanewa Shah E Karbala
